"""Starts pgAdmin 4 for Stackyard: desktop mode, bound to 127.0.0.1.

Stackyard runs:  python stackyard_pgadmin.py <panel.json> <data dir> <log file>
panel.json is rewritten on every start with the port, a fresh access key and
the installed PostgreSQL services (no passwords). Put extra pgAdmin settings
in SETTINGS below or in a config_local.py next to this file.
"""
import json
import os
import runpy
import sys
import sysconfig
import types

SETTINGS = {
    "UPGRADE_CHECK_ENABLED": False,
}
GROUP = "Stackyard"


def sync_servers(targets):
    """Adds/updates one entry per Stackyard PostgreSQL service; never deletes."""
    import config
    from pgadmin.model import Server, ServerGroup, User, db

    user = User.query.filter_by(email=config.DESKTOP_USER).first()
    if user is None:
        return
    group = ServerGroup.query.filter_by(user_id=user.id, name=GROUP).first()
    if group is None:
        group = ServerGroup(user_id=user.id, name=GROUP)
        db.session.add(group)
        db.session.commit()
    for t in targets:
        name = "PostgreSQL %s" % t["version"]
        server = Server.query.filter_by(user_id=user.id, servergroup_id=group.id, name=name).first()
        if server is None:
            server = Server(
                user_id=user.id, servergroup_id=group.id, name=name, maintenance_db="postgres",
                save_password=0, use_ssh_tunnel=0, shared=False, kerberos_conn=False, is_adhoc=0,
                connection_params={"sslmode": "prefer", "connect_timeout": 10},
            )
            db.session.add(server)
        server.host = t["host"]
        server.port = t["port"]
        server.username = t["user"] or "postgres"
    db.session.commit()


def main():
    panel_file, data_dir, log_file = sys.argv[1:4]
    with open(panel_file, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        panel = json.load(f)

    os.environ["PGADMIN_SERVER_MODE"] = "OFF"
    os.environ["PGADMIN_INT_PORT"] = str(panel["port"])
    os.environ["PGADMIN_INT_KEY"] = panel["token"]
    os.environ.pop("CONFIG_DISTRO_FILE_PATH", None)

    distro = types.ModuleType("config_distro")
    distro.DATA_DIR = data_dir
    distro.LOG_FILE = log_file
    distro.DEFAULT_SERVER = "127.0.0.1"
    for key, value in SETTINGS.items():
        setattr(distro, key, value)
    sys.modules["config_distro"] = distro

    entry = os.path.join(sysconfig.get_paths()["purelib"], "pgadmin4", "pgAdmin4.py")
    sys.argv = [entry]
    pgadmin = runpy.run_path(entry, run_name="stackyard_pgadmin")
    with pgadmin["app"].app_context():
        sync_servers(panel.get("targets", []))
    print("pgAdmin listening on http://127.0.0.1:%d" % panel["port"], flush=True)
    pgadmin["main"]()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
